step6_output.answer_core: Option 3 is viable, but only if you verify the conditions before committing. Start by asking your advisor directly whether he supports a cross‑lab direction, whether funding covers it, and whether he is comfortable with a real co‑advisor structure. If that support is clear, then meet with the single‑cell postdoc to confirm whether the data are actually accessible, what their PI would require, and what authorship expectations look like. Don’t lock anything in with your committee until both support and data access are firm. Set yourself an 18‑month checkpoint: if no publishable progress on the pipeline exists by then, shift to a narrower tumor‑evolution project that you can complete on your own timeline.
